title: Scope: Pre-Launch Django & PostgreSQL Multi-Tenant Security Review
brief: Pre-launch security review and authorised testing against a dedicated test environment for a multi-tenant Django and PostgreSQL SaaS handling customers, invoices, files, and roles. Deliver an initial risk assessment, severity-rated findings, practical developer fixes in plain English, and a follow-up re-test.
summary: Systematic manual + script-assisted audit of Django views/serializers, PostgreSQL tenant scoping, session/MFA flows, invoice calculations, and file upload handling on your test environment, ending with plain-English fixes and a verification re-test.

code: Automated Django security settings, dependency CVE scan, Bandit static rules, and PostgreSQL/ORM raw-SQL review
Cross-tenant IDOR & RBAC matrix tests verifying Tenant A cannot read/write Tenant B records, invoices, or uploaded files
Invoice/payment server-side tampering, password reset/MFA token expiry, and file upload MIME/path-traversal verification
ai: Plain-English translation and prioritized remediation walkthrough tailored for a non-developer founder + engineering backlog
Triage helper correlating endpoint routes against Django permissions decorators to spot unprotected views quickly

milestones.deliverable: Confirm isolated test environment rules of engagement, review Django settings/deployment config, and deliver risk snapshot
Test RBAC/IDOR tenant boundaries, MFA/reset flows, invoice math integrity, uploads, and SQL/XSS/CSRF controls
Severity-ranked report with plain-English summary, exact code patches, and follow-up verification re-test

monthlyOps: One-off pre-launch test engagement ($0 recurring runtime cost; optional CI security checks via GitHub Actions free tier).
questions: Will test accounts for at least 2 separate tenant businesses and each user role (admin, staff, customer) be available on the test env?
Is the payment/invoice workflow using Stripe/GoCardless webhooks or internal invoice state transitions on the test site?
Would read-only source access to the Django repo be shared for faster code-level verification alongside black-box endpoint testing?
pitch: Hi Gemma! I put together a clear step-by-step security review plan for your Django + PostgreSQL multi-tenant app: https://beelsik.github.io/portfolio/?src=pph&task=pph-django-audit
